title: Working with HTTP APIs

spans.text: Check HTTP status, headers, and body separately. External APIs can be slow or unavailable; set timeouts, bound response sizes, and validate returned JSON.

spans.code:
from urllib.request import urlopen

with urlopen('https://example.com', timeout=5) as response:
    print(response.status)
Usually 200 for a successful request; network, server, and policy can change the result.

spans.text: A timeout prevents a network call from blocking indefinitely.

spans.title: Important tip
spans.text: Retry only operations safe to repeat, and cap the number of attempts.

visual_description: A separate visual is not essential; a small runnable code example and its expected output explain the topic.
